pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Core widgets, models, and utilities for all Proxmox ExtJS-based web UIs. Provides proxmoxlib.js (and .min.js) — the bundled JS library loaded by pve-manager, proxmox-backup, and other Proxmox web interfaces.
Build process at emerge time: - Concatenates ~80 JS source files + marked.js → proxmoxlib.js - Minifies with uglifyjs → proxmoxlib.min.js - Compiles SCSS dark theme with sassc → theme-proxmox-dark.css
Installed to /usr/share/javascript/proxmox-widget-toolkit/
Note: node/APT.js and node/APTRepositories.js are installed but will render empty on Gentoo (no apt backend). This matches the APT stub applied to the Perl layer in proxmox-perl-rs.
